deleteSession.title: Delete session?
deleteSession.body: This permanently removes the session — its messages, background jobs, and extraction records. Everything it added to the graph stays unless you check below. This cannot be undone.

traces.title: Also remove its graph traces
traces.body: This session’s topics, links, and events leave the graph too. Topics other sessions or imported notes also cover survive; topics only this session created are removed entirely.

deleteSource.title: Delete selected sources and folders?
deleteSource.contributions: Removes these sources’ contributions to propositions and reasoning chains. Knowledge supported by other sources survives; knowledge supported only by these sources is removed.
deleteSource.records: Imported source records are removed, but original files on disk are never changed. Selected folders are removed only when empty; folders needed by kept sessions remain.
deleteSource.sessionsBody: Unchecked, conversations stay in their current folders and can be extracted again. Either way, their graph contributions and extraction coverage are cleared. Checking this also permanently deletes their messages and background jobs.
